correctness.rationale: Fundamental theorem of calculus, conditional exponential memorylessness, and covariance of uniform indicators establish the two Hilbert-valued integral kernels. Integrating their nonnegative scalar kernels gives sharp common 2L²η⁴ attained by affine h. Smooth nonnegative derivative bumps on opposite sides of η give strict sign reversal; test-function uniqueness forces a(S)=η and b(S)=S−η. Proof handles constant paths and general η>0, and absolute-integrability follows bounded derivative.
